title: Cristate
summary: CRISTATE, CRISTATED, adjective [Latin , a crest.] In botany, crested; tufted; having an appendage like a crest or tuft, as some anthers and flowers.

inlines.v: CRISTATE, CRISTATED, adjective [Latin , a crest.] In botany, crested; tufted; having an appendage like a crest or tuft, as some anthers and flowers.
